articles.title: Russell fastest in Las Vegas practice after rain
articles.teaser: Mercedes' George Russell topped a second practice session at the Las Vegas Grand Prix run on a wet but slowly drying track.

articles.title: F1 Las Vegas GP: Russell fastest in damp FP2 from Gasly
articles.teaser: George Russell pipped Pierre Gasly to go fastest in second practice for the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix thanks to a late time in slippery conditions. The Mercedes driver set a 1m47.272s at the chequered flag which…

digest: Coverage centred on George Russell topping second practice for Mercedes on a wet but slowly drying track (BBC Sport). Autosport added that he pipped Pierre Gasly with a late 1m47.272s at the chequered flag in slippery conditions. The other storyline was Red Bull, which was "trying to understand" the root cause of Verstappen's complaints, described as "same as Brazil" (Autosport). Isack Hadjar finished fourth, though Autosport noted all teams were left with very few answers after Thursday's sessions.
